chunks: And whatever was in it from al-Husayn ibn Zayd, I have narrated it from Muhammad ibn Ali Majiluwayh—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from al-Husayn ibn Zayd ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon them.

key_terms.الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ: The narrator from whom these reports are transmitted.
key_terms.الْعَطَّارِ: A nisbah identifying Muhammad ibn Yahya as al-Attar.
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: A supplicatory honorific meaning: may Allah be pleased with him.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; an explicit statement of narration by the compiler.
key_terms.عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ: Honorific supplication: peace be upon them.

ai.seo_question: What is the chain of transmission to al-Husayn ibn Zayd in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from al-Husayn ibn Zayd. Its significance is in documenting the chain of transmission and identifying the narrators through whom this material reached the compiler.
